_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bank', "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "default_spending_source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "include_in_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_total" IN (0, 1)), "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4279592384, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bank', "note" TEXT NULL, "goal_amount" INTEGER NULL, "goal_date" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "linked_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "expected_amount" INTEGER NULL, "pay_schedule_type" TEXT NULL, "pay_day" INTEGER NULL, "pay_interval_days" INTEGER NULL, "pay_anchor_date" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4281236786, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'work', "note" TEXT NULL, "is_built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_built_in" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_opening_allocations" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "source_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4284513675, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'category', "default_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "default_source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "default_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id), "total_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "original_due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reminder_at" INTEGER NULL, "reminder_repeat_days" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "written_off_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "period_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subscriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "billing_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "billing_every" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "next_due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_day" INTEGER NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "reminder_days_before" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "person_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "due_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES dues (id), "subscription_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES subscriptions (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES income_sources (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "due_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dues (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "old_date" INTEGER NULL, "new_date" INTEGER NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "edited_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "remind_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repeat" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "repeat_every_days" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_log" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_snooze" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_snooze" IN (0, 1)), "handled_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_date ON transactions (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_to_account ON transactions (to_account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_due ON transactions (due_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_alloc_tx ON transaction_allocations (transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_alloc_source ON transaction_allocations (source_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_due_events_due ON due_events (due_id)
